properties.title: Transaction Authorization Popup Preconditions
properties.description: Before displaying authorization popup, dapp must have initiated eth_sendTransaction request with valid transaction parameters
properties.formal_expression: FORALL popup : AuthorizationPopup :: popup.opened IMPLIES EXISTS request : eth_sendTransaction :: request.triggered(popup) AND request.params.valid()

properties.title: User Rejection Returns Cancel Error
properties.description: When user clicks reject in the popup, the transaction request must return a cancel error to the dapp
properties.formal_expression: FORALL decision : UserDecision :: decision.action == REJECT IMPLIES response.error.type == 'cancel' AND response.result == null

properties.title: Account Unlock Window Duration
properties.description: Account unlock window for personal API must not exceed 3 seconds
properties.formal_expression: FORALL unlock : AccountUnlock :: unlock.duration <= 3_SECONDS AND unlock.expires_at == unlock.start_time + 3_SECONDS

properties.title: Read-Only RPC Method Whitelist Check
properties.description: Before executing RPC call via iframe, the method must be validated against the 43-method whitelist
properties.formal_expression: FORALL rpc : IframeRPCRequest :: rpc.execute() IMPLIES rpc.method IN allowedMethods[43]

properties.title: Non-Whitelisted Method Returns notAllowed Error
properties.description: Methods not in the whitelist must return a notAllowed error type
properties.formal_expression: FORALL rpc : IframeRPCRequest :: rpc.method NOT IN allowedMethods IMPLIES response.error.type == 'notAllowed'

properties.title: eth_sign Method Prohibition
properties.description: eth_sign method must always be prohibited regardless of authorization path
properties.formal_expression: FORALL request : RPCRequest :: request.method == 'eth_sign' IMPLIES request.rejected() AND NEVER request.executed()

properties.title: Transaction Parameter Validation
properties.description: eth_sendTransaction must include from, to, gas, and gasPrice fields before authorization
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : SendTransaction :: tx.authorized() IMPLIES tx.params.from != null AND tx.params.to != null AND tx.params.gas != null AND tx.params.gasPrice != null

properties.title: Missing Fields Return notValid Error
properties.description: Transactions missing required fields must return notValid error with specific message
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : SendTransaction :: (tx.params.from == null OR tx.params.to == null OR tx.params.gas == null OR tx.params.gasPrice == null) IMPLIES response.error.type == 'notValid' AND response.error.message CONTAINS 'Need to specify'

properties.title: Error Response Format Invariant
properties.description: All error responses must have matching request id, null result, and error object with type
properties.formal_expression: FORALL response : RPCResponse :: response.is_error IMPLIES response.id == request.id AND response.result == null AND response.error.type IN {'cancel', 'JsonParse', 'noConnection', 'notAllowed', 'notValid'}

properties.title: Browser Same-Origin Policy Trust
properties.description: Authorization iframe must rely on browser same-origin policy for cross-origin isolation
properties.formal_expression: FORALL iframe : AuthorizationIframe :: iframe.cross_origin_requests == BLOCKED BY browser.same_origin_policy

properties.title: Transaction Begin Requires Empty or Nested State
properties.description: begin_transaction can only be called when no snapshots exist or within an existing transaction
properties.formal_expression: FORALL state : State, begin : BeginTransaction :: begin.valid() IMPLIES (state._snapshots.empty() OR state._snapshots.length() > 0)

properties.title: Begin Transaction Creates Snapshot
properties.description: After begin_transaction, snapshot stack must contain copy of main_trie, storage_tries, and created_accounts
properties.formal_expression: FORALL begin : BeginTransaction :: AFTER(begin) IMPLIES state._snapshots.length() == OLD(state._snapshots.length()) + 1 AND state._snapshots.top().main_trie == OLD(state.main_trie).copy()

properties.title: Rollback Restores Pre-Transaction State
properties.description: After rollback_transaction, main_trie and storage_tries must match the popped snapshot values
properties.formal_expression: FORALL rollback : RollbackTransaction :: AFTER(rollback) IMPLIES state.main_trie == OLD(state._snapshots.top()).main_trie AND state.storage_tries == OLD(state._snapshots.top()).storage_tries

properties.title: Snapshot Stack Depth Integrity
properties.description: Commit and rollback must decrease snapshot stack by exactly one
properties.formal_expression: FORALL op : (CommitTransaction | RollbackTransaction) :: AFTER(op) IMPLIES state._snapshots.length() == OLD(state._snapshots.length()) - 1

properties.title: Outermost Commit Clears Created Accounts
properties.description: When committing the outermost transaction (last snapshot), created_accounts set must be cleared
properties.formal_expression: FORALL commit : CommitTransaction :: OLD(state._snapshots.length()) == 1 AND AFTER(commit) IMPLIES state.created_accounts == EMPTY_SET

properties.title: State Root Computation Requires Empty Snapshots
properties.description: state_root and storage_root may only be called when no snapshots are active
properties.formal_expression: FORALL root_call : (StateRoot | StorageRoot) :: root_call.valid() IMPLIES state._snapshots.empty()

properties.title: Account Creation Adds to Created Set
properties.description: Creating a new account must add the address to created_accounts set
properties.formal_expression: FORALL create : CreateAccount :: create.address NOT IN OLD(state.accounts) IMPLIES AFTER(create) create.address IN state.created_accounts

properties.title: Empty Account Auto-Destruction
properties.description: After modify_state, accounts with nonce=0, empty code, and zero balance must be destroyed
properties.formal_expression: FORALL modify : ModifyState :: AFTER(modify) AND account.nonce == 0 AND account.code.empty() AND account.balance == 0 IMPLIES account.destroyed()

properties.title: Account Destruction Clears Storage
properties.description: When an account is destroyed, its entire storage trie must also be destroyed
properties.formal_expression: FORALL destroy : DestroyAccount :: AFTER(destroy) IMPLIES state.storage_tries[destroy.address] == null

properties.title: Get Account Returns EMPTY_ACCOUNT for Nonexistent
properties.description: get_account for addresses not in trie must return EMPTY_ACCOUNT
properties.formal_expression: FORALL get : GetAccount :: get.address NOT IN state.main_trie IMPLIES get.result == EMPTY_ACCOUNT

properties.title: Get Storage Returns Zero for Missing Keys
properties.description: get_storage for keys not in storage trie must return U256(0)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL get : GetStorage :: get.key NOT IN state.storage_tries[get.address] IMPLIES get.result == U256(0)

properties.title: Writing Zero Deletes Storage Key
properties.description: set_storage with U256(0) must delete the key from storage trie
properties.formal_expression: FORALL set : SetStorage :: set.value == U256(0) IMPLIES AFTER(set) set.key NOT IN state.storage_tries[set.address]

properties.title: Get Storage Original Requires Active Snapshot
properties.description: get_storage_original must have at least one snapshot to read pre-transaction value
properties.formal_expression: FORALL get_orig : GetStorageOriginal :: get_orig.valid() IMPLIES state._snapshots.length() >= 1

properties.title: Original Storage Reads from First Snapshot
properties.description: get_storage_original must always read from the first (oldest) snapshot in the stack
properties.formal_expression: FORALL get_orig : GetStorageOriginal :: get_orig.result == state._snapshots[0].storage_tries[get_orig.address].get(get_orig.key, U256(0))

properties.title: Transient Storage Returns Zero When Empty
properties.description: TLOAD for keys not in transient storage must return U256(0)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tload : TLOAD :: tload.key NOT IN transient_storage[tload.address] IMPLIES tload.result == U256(0)

properties.title: Transient Storage Rollback on Revert
properties.description: When a nested call reverts, transient storage must be restored to pre-call state
properties.formal_expression: FORALL revert : NestedCallRevert :: AFTER(revert) IMPLIES transient_storage == OLD(transient_snapshot).transient_storage

properties.title: Balance Transfer Requires Sufficient Sender Balance
properties.description: move_ether requires sender balance >= transfer amount
properties.formal_expression: FORALL transfer : MoveEther :: transfer.valid() IMPLIES get_account(transfer.sender).balance >= transfer.amount

properties.title: Balance Transfer Conservation
properties.description: move_ether must conserve total ether: sender loses exactly what recipient gains
properties.formal_expression: FORALL transfer : MoveEther :: OLD(sender.balance) + OLD(recipient.balance) == NEW(sender.balance) + NEW(recipient.balance)

properties.title: ForkID Calculation Requires Genesis Hash
properties.description: FORK_HASH calculation requires genesis block hash to be loaded
properties.formal_expression: FORALL calc : ComputeForkHash :: calc.valid() IMPLIES state.genesis_hash != null AND state.genesis_hash.length == 32

properties.title: FORK_HASH CRC32 Calculation Integrity
properties.description: FORK_HASH must be IEEE CRC32 of genesis hash combined with completed fork block numbers/timestamps in ascending order
properties.formal_expression: FORALL forkid : ForkID :: forkid.FORK_HASH == CRC32(genesis_hash || sorted_completed_forks)

properties.title: ForkID Contains Both Components
properties.description: After ForkID computation, both FORK_HASH and FORK_NEXT must be populated
properties.formal_expression: FORALL forkid : ForkID :: forkid.ready IMPLIES forkid.FORK_HASH != null AND forkid.FORK_NEXT != null

properties.title: FORK_NEXT Zero When No Future Fork
properties.description: FORK_NEXT must be 0 when no future fork is scheduled
properties.formal_expression: FORALL forkid : ForkID :: (no_future_forks_scheduled) IMPLIES forkid.FORK_NEXT == 0

properties.title: Peer ForkID Validation Requires Local ForkID
properties.description: Before validating remote peer ForkID, local node must have computed its own ForkID
properties.formal_expression: FORALL validation : ValidateForkID :: validation.valid() IMPLIES local_node.forkid.ready

properties.title: Compatible ForkID Allows Connection
properties.description: When peer ForkID matches local configuration, connection must be accepted
properties.formal_expression: FORALL validation : ValidateForkID :: validation.result == COMPATIBLE IMPLIES peer.connection.accepted()

properties.title: Stale Remote Peer Rejection
properties.description: When remote peer has outdated fork information, connection must be rejected with ErrRemoteStale
properties.formal_expression: FORALL validation : ValidateForkID :: validation.result == REMOTE_STALE IMPLIES peer.connection.rejected() AND error.type == 'ErrRemoteStale'

properties.title: Local Incompatible Peer Rejection
properties.description: When local node is incompatible with remote peer, connection must be rejected
properties.formal_expression: FORALL validation : ValidateForkID :: validation.result == LOCAL_INCOMPATIBLE IMPLIES peer.connection.rejected() AND error.type == 'ErrLocalIncompatibleOrStale'

properties.title: Fork Schedule Loading Precondition
properties.description: Fork ordering validation requires complete fork schedule to be loaded
properties.formal_expression: FORALL validation : ValidateForkOrdering :: validation.valid() IMPLIES fork_schedule.loaded AND fork_schedule.complete

properties.title: Timestamp Forks After Block Forks
properties.description: All timestamp-based forks must be scheduled at or after all block-based forks
properties.formal_expression: FORALL schedule : ForkSchedule :: FORALL ts_fork : TimestampFork, blk_fork : BlockFork :: ts_fork.activation >= blk_fork.activation

properties.title: Duplicate Fork Entries Checksummed Once
properties.description: Fork entries with duplicate block numbers or timestamps must be checksummed only once
properties.formal_expression: FORALL schedule : ForkSchedule :: checksum_input == deduplicate(sorted_forks)

properties.title: Fork Activation Triggers Recalculation
properties.description: When a new fork activates, FORK_HASH and FORK_NEXT must be recalculated
properties.formal_expression: FORALL activation : ForkActivation :: AFTER(activation) IMPLIES forkid.FORK_HASH == CRC32(genesis_hash || OLD(completed_forks) + activation.fork) AND forkid.FORK_NEXT == next_scheduled_fork()
